text:
The Professional Face Lifting class was an amazing learning experience. I’ve studied Head and Face massage at several other Thai schools, and I even teach it at my own school. But I signed up for this course as much to learn from Dr. Nooy as to explore this specific modality.

And now I've just completed an incredible two-week, 60-hour journey learning Traditional Thai Abdominal Detox Massage with Dr. Nooy.  I have never been more exhausted from learning, but never been more satisfied with how much I have learned in these two weeks.

From day one, I was blown away by this Dr. Nooy's techniques. Not a single technique overlapped with what I already knew from hundreds of hours of studying Thai massage. Plus Dr. Nooy’s teaching style focused on identifying what needed to be addressed rather than simply memorizing a sequence without considering the client’s unique needs.

I was fortunate to be her only student for the Abdominal course, which meant that Dr. Nooy taught me at the speed I could understand. In the first week I did feel a bit overwhelmed, but after countless hours of working with clients that she brought in for me, by the end of the second week I was doing 2-hour treatments using techniques that were all new to me.

The abdomen is essential to Traditional Thai Medicine for a number of reasons, but this is the first school and the first teacher who has not only given me practical techniques for working the abdomen, but, more importantly, helped me understand how to assess and treat what needs to be done for my clients.

I haven’t even returned home to Canada yet, but I already have numerous bookings from clients eager to try both the Thai Face Lifting and the Thai Abdominal massage treatments. I highly recommend these courses to anyone looking to learn from a true master in the field.

I am forever grateful that I found Sirichan Thai massage school. Thank you Dr. Nooy for the gift you have given me.

I had the pleasure of learning from Nooy, and I can confidently say she is a truly wonderful teacher. Her knowledge, patience, and passion for massage therapy made every minute of the learning experience enjoyable and enriching. She creates a comfortable and encouraging environment, and her teaching style is both clear and hands-on. I walked away not only with new skills but also with a deeper appreciation for the art of massage. Thank you, Nooy, for your guidance and inspiration!

This is not just another standard massage. Here, you get real treatment tailored to your specific needs. It can be painful, as it was in my case, since I came with tension I've had for many years. But Dr. Nooy really knows what she is doing and provides the right treatment. I highly recommend her.

I met dr Nooy during some emotional difficulties and she was like a sunshine after a heavy storm. She did amatarot treatment for me first and I decided to start the training with her after.

The way she teaches goes far beyond verbal communication. It was like her presence silently guided me in understanding of many aspects at once as it was not only about bodywork but life itself.

She is a rare mixture of quiet wisdom, humbleness and such a great child-like spirit<3

I highly recommend her and her clinic to anyone who is looking for top notch treatments and trainings.

Thank you Nooy for being you!

The best massage I ever did. The doctor broke me and put me back together. I felt brand new afterward.
It felt really medical and not just for fun. She really knows what she's doing.
Highly recommended!!

Sirichan is an amazing doctor with deep knowledg, care and skills. Stomach massage has been so healing for me,  and I also appreciate how she is able to find and balance whatever is needed with therapeutic Thai massage. …

Sirichan Clinic is so much more than the best massage you'll ever get.
Having been in Asia for over a year, I've made frequent visits to massage places with mixed success.
Sirichan Clinic is definitely a unique treatment compared to anything else!

Dr. Sirichan Maneechai, aka Nooy, began learning traditional massage and medicine at the age of 8 from her grandmother Wissim. She later pursued formal education, eventually earning a doctorate in Thai medicine, midwifery, and massage therapy.
Dr. Nooy has since developed her own unique approach to healing, incorporating over 12 Thai modalities. She specializes in a range of treatments, including traditional Thai massage, face massage, and herbal treatments, among others. Her approach is holistic, combining expertise with a clear understanding of health, body, and mind.

You won't only get a massage. Dr. Nooy will give you the check-up that you perhaps didn't even know you needed! She fixed my leg so I could walk again and adjusted a muscle in my other leg. Furthermore, she worked on my entire body, using both acupuncture and abdominal massage.
I came out as a new functional being!
Before I went, she even gave me herbal medicine to drink before bedtime!
This is the treatment we dream about every time we visit a masseuse!
Thank you so much for a calm and holistic experience that I have never before encountered!
Treat yourself to this. It's a true blessing 🙏☯️

Being already a certified massage therapist, I was looking some who could teach me new skills and techniques. So I chose Dr. Nooy's clinic in order to learn the art of traditional thai massage and bone setting.
After taking the courses, I can only recommend Sirichan clinic and dr. Nooy to anyone who wants to seriously study massage in order to be able to heal others. Not only were the lessons very comprehensive, but Dr. Nooy has always been available to explain the details, demonstrate the techniques and clarify all doubts.
Certainly what distinguishes this course is a great attention to the correct learning of the student and the application of massage techniques as a real tool to help the client heal. Furthermore, during the practice I had the opportunity to follow and massage various people and clients of the clinic, immediately putting into practice what I had learned. This is really a big plus, since in many massage courses you usually only practice with other students. Here, however, you have the opportunity to put into practice what you have learned on real cases, under the careful supervision of Dr. Nooy. Furthermore, the atmosphere is pleasant, familiar and relaxed, which certainly favors learning.
If you are looking for a traditional Thai massage course or if you are looking for someone who can help you solve physical problems through this art of care, look no further and trust the Sirichan Clinic.

I recently completed the entire 4-week course with Dr. Nooy and her team and was truly satisfied with the wonderful Thai massage, walking massage, and bonesetting sequences I learned. Nooy teaches using a traditional method, emphasizing the development of the ability to sense the qualities of the body's tissues, all with a clinical approach. Therefore, in addition to the sequences with the related SEN SIB theory, you acquire the tools to perform a careful assessment of the body to perform functional, personalized, and completely safe treatments. Furthermore, she and her team, in addition to being generous and empathetic, are open to receiving during the lessons, and as a result, you receive precise and useful feedback to understand exactly how to correctly perform the techniques. Thanks to Fred in particular, I was able to clearly understand mistakes and correct them session after session. Furthermore, you have the opportunity to participate in the clinical evaluation of her clients.
It's important to remember that Nooy is a traditional doctor and knows the various aspects of Thai medicine. Being very accessible, one has the opportunity to gain a wealth of information on this immense subject, in addition to receiving his highly effective treatments.
Thank you, Sirichan School, for your professionalism and kindness. I will always cherish this experience.

I’ll be back.

Before posting this review I waited more than a week with my bad feelings about this Clinic hoping it would pass as it usually does, when they did not go away I decided to write them & ask what happened, why I was treated so poorly. I want to make clear they instantly wrote back & were very apologetic. They explained they had forgotten to put me on the schedule & if there was anything they could do to fix it. I said it is too late for me but to please make sure it does not happen to another person. Please if you go make sure it is confirmed more than once because I confirmed twice & was still not on the schedule.

I do not like to leave poor reviews but I think people should be cautioned & make their decisions to go here accordingly. This place does have many good reviews so read those as well. I reached out based on reviews & research.

After many years of dealing with a deeply personal problem. I tried medical & psychological (nothing wrong). I tried spiritual healing & then was told I should try the famous “Thai Karasi Massage” for women, that Chang Mai was the very best place to do it. I got the courage to ask for help & told them deeply personal things. They wrote back with a time on the one day I told them I could be in Chang Mai City. I was told “The assessment and treatment are done by Dr Nooy herself. The price is normally 5,000 THB, but it can go up to 8,000 THB according to each case. We can have you assessed” I thought this meant assessed for the price, it did not occur to me that she would not treat me.  I would have booked someone else.

When I arrived, they told me “wait outside” as they were taking pictures with students who just completed a course. I did not mind waiting as they all seemed very happy. Then the doctor “saw” me by showing a nice students I was the perfect example of “an egg- like hard bone- feel, feel” on my abdomen around the area of my woumb without explaining what that meant. Then she shrugged her should & said “it’s emotional” in the most dismissive way. She also said “I had too much fascia on my back”. What does too much fascia even mean? I am glad that as a medical professional at least I knew what fascia is or she would have worried me even more than she did with the unexplained “egg” comment.

She said I needed a regular massage that day because I was tense, of course I was tense it is a very personal treatment.  I had a 2 hour deep Thai massage a few days earlier so I did not need another massage. She said I could return the next day because she had to “Go for Chinese New Year”. This & focus on taking pictures of the “Completed Course Students” makes me know she never planned to treat me that day.

I became upset because I made so much effort to come & see her since I was leaving the next day. I said “no, I do not want a massage I want the treatment” She then said “ok” so I thought I was getting the treatment. Another lady stared a massage to “loosen my fascia” while I believed I was waiting for her to return & give me the treatment. So I ended up getting a massage that I clearly said “no” to all the while waiting for the treatment like an fool. Then I was told “finished” & charged 1,000 baht. Again, I said no to a normal massage, if she was honest & said she would not treat me that day I would have left. Instead, I ended up leaving feeling cheated & horribly mistreated. I can not even imagine the damage this kind of behavior could cause someone younger or more emotionally vulnerable. I do not recommend this place. I find it incredibly unethical. This is not a place of “healing” for me it was a place of “hurting”.

If the Dr has decided to prioritizing teaching healers that can then go on to heal many around the world over healing individuals this is a beautiful decision but it should be clarified. Call it a “Healing School” Instead of a “Clinic”. Make it clear on the site & e-mails to prevent individual people like me from experiencing what I did. Also, if you decide to do both just don’t book clients on days of teaching.

Very disappointing.  Basically just a 500 baht Lanna hammer-style massage you can get in the temples for 150 baht.  Stopped by a few days before and was told they integrate various techniques and read your body.  Didn't happen.  Spoke with the older woman who runs the place and thought I would get her but instead was passed to another person.  Hammered most of the hour and my arm fell asleep, which has never happened before.  No leg work, just upper body,  no usage of "various techniques", just apply tiger balm and hammer away.  When I voiced my displeasure, was greeted with a blank stare and a water bottle. The space is cramped and there is a lot going on and lots of talking, so not very relaxing.  Think the great reviews are for the classes, most likely.  Wish reviewers were more discerning and detailed in their reviews so as to be more helpful.  Save your money and go to the temples.  Nothing special here and no emphasis on the customer.  Won't return for a "massage", at least.
